title: III. Circumcision
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): It designated circumcision belonging toward ye heart by ye Spirit (Deut. 10:16; Rom. 2:28-29; Col. 2:11) and Christ coming in ye flesh. Ye eighth day shadowed Christ's resurrection and ye beginning belonging toward ye new age. — III. CIRCUMCISION stood as an Old Testament sacrament by which, with ye foreskin belonging toward ye little boy cut off on ye eighth day from birth, God's covenant with Abraham and his seed stood as sealed (Gen. 17).
pass_b_english: III. CIRCUMCISION was an Old Testament sacrament by which, with the foreskin of the little boy cut off on the eighth day from birth, God's covenant with Abraham and his seed was sealed (Gen. 17).

It designated circumcision of the heart by the Spirit (Deut. 10:16; Rom. 2:28-29; Col. 2:11) and Christ coming in the flesh. The eighth day shadowed Christ's resurrection and the beginning of the new age.
source_text: III. CIRCUMCISIO fuit sacramentum V.T. quo amputata pellicula praeputii pueruli octavo die a nativitate foedus Dei cum Abrahamo & semine eius obsignabatur, Gen. 17. Designabat circumcisionem cordis per Spiritum (Deut. 10:16; Rom. 2:28-29; Col. 2:11) & Christum in carne venturum. Octavus dies typum resurrectionis Christi & novi saeculi initium adumbravit.
